findings.claim: 10-K 列出光通訊主要競爭者為 Amphenol、Fujikura、Sumitomo、Prysmian；公司稱維持領導地位，但承認競爭格局含整併與價格壓力，且不保證能維持或提升市占。
findings.excerpt: We maintain a leadership position in the segment’s principal product groups, which include carrier and enterprise networks. The competitive landscape includes industry consolidation, pricing pressure and competition for the innovation of new products. These competitive conditions are likely to persist.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：光通訊與顯示器貢獻大量利潤，價格、數量或市占的顯著下滑會對財務造成重大負面影響。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: Corning’s Optical Communications and Display segments generate a significant amount of the Company’s profits and cash flow; any significant decrease in pricing, volume or market share could have a material and negative impact on our financial results

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到光纖專屬市占數據、新進入者或被對手取代的來源；僅有 Meta/Nvidia/Amazon 長約報導（未讀原文，未列入 findings）。無 2026 具名競爭 design win 來源。

clues.claim: Corning 2026 年簽下 Meta（最高 $6B）、Nvidia（最高 $3.2B）、Amazon 光纖長約，顯示超大規模客戶綁定。
clues.source: Nasdaq - GLW Rides on Solid Traction in Optical Communication
